title: Linus Torvalds Ends the AI Debate With One Brutal Line
description:
Linus Torvalds just killed the AI debate in one line. Devs wanted him to ban AI tools from the Linux kernel, his reply was basically "fork it or leave" and he promised to "very loudly ignore" any ban calls 😅 After 35 years running the worlds biggest open source project, thats a signal. AI in serious dev isnt the exception now, its the norm 🔥

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
